newsHighlights.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; finance chief named interim leader
newsHighlights.summary: Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang resigned as president, chief executive and board member effective immediately, with CFO Colette Kress named interim leader.
newsHighlights.translation: 英伟达宣布黄仁勋即日起辞去总裁、首席执行官及董事职务，首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯被任命为临时领导人。

newsHighlights.title: China, US hold political dialogue in Beijing
newsHighlights.summary: A senior Chinese official said candid, in-depth and constructive views were exchanged at the US-China Political Dialogue 2026 held in Beijing.
newsHighlights.translation: 一位中国高级官员表示，在北京举行的2026年中美政治对话中，双方坦诚、深入、建设性地交换了意见。

newsHighlights.title: Xi calls for unity to carry on Sun Yat-sen's legacy
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping called on Chinese people at home and abroad to unite more closely, carry forward Sun Yat-sen's legacy and work together for national rejuvenation.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席号召海内外中华儿女更加紧密地团结起来，弘扬孙中山先生的精神遗产，共同致力于民族复兴。

newsHighlights.title: Chinese VP urges stronger collective climate action at COP31
newsHighlights.summary: The Chinese vice-president urged stronger collective climate action at COP31, calling for shared responsibility among all parties.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国国家副主席在第三十一届联合国气候变化大会上敦促采取更有力的集体气候行动，呼吁各方共同承担责任。

newsHighlights.title: NVIDIA's market value falls below $4 trillion for the first time since July 2025
newsHighlights.summary: Nvidia's market value slipped below $4 trillion for the first time since July 2025 amid the leadership shake-up.
newsHighlights.translation: 在领导层变动之际，英伟达市值自2025年7月以来首次跌破4万亿美元。

quote.quote: The single biggest problem in communication is the illusion that it has taken place.
quote.author: George Bernard Shaw
quote.translation: 沟通中最大的问题，是误以为沟通已经发生了。
quote.explanation: 这句话提醒我们：无论是高管交接还是国际对话，真正的沟通不是“说了”，而是确认对方听懂并达成共识。职场中切忌假设信息已经传达到位。

pattern.pattern: call on sb. to do sth. —— 号召/呼吁某人做某事（用于正式沟通与职场动员）
pattern.example: President Xi called on Chinese people at home and abroad to unite more closely and carry forward Sun Yat-sen's legacy.
pattern.translation: 习近平主席号召海内外中华儿女更加紧密地团结起来，弘扬孙中山先生的精神遗产。
pattern.usage: 结构：call on + 人 + to do。语气正式，常用于演讲、会议动员与管理沟通。近义表达：urge sb. to do、appeal to sb. to do。否定式可用 call on sb. not to do。例：The CEO called on all departments to submit their reports by Friday.（首席执行官要求各部门周五前提交报告。）

grammar.title: 新闻英语中的被动语态（Passive Voice）
grammar.explanation: 当动作的执行者不重要、未知或需要突出动作承受者时，英语新闻常用被动语态：be + 过去分词（+ by 短语）。在职场沟通中，被动语态常用于正式公告、人事任免和会议纪要，以显得客观中立。常见搭配：be named（被任命）、be exchanged（被交换）、be announced（被宣布）。
examples: Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress was named interim leader of the company.
Candid, in-depth and constructive views were exchanged at the US-China Political Dialogue 2026.

pronunciation.tips: 注意三点：① 重音在第二个音节 /zaɪn/，首音节 /rɪ/ 要轻读；② 字母 s 在这里发浊辅音 /z/，不是 /s/；③ 结尾的 g 不发音，读作 /zaɪn/ 而非 /zaɪɡn/。同类发音还有 design /dɪˈzaɪn/、sign /saɪn/。
examples: Jensen Huang resigned as president and chief executive.
She resigned from the board effective immediately.

reading.title: A Sudden Handover: What Nvidia's Leadership Change Teaches Us About Workplace Communication
reading.content: On Thursday, Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang had resigned as president, chief executive and board member, effective immediately. The company did not give a reason for his departure. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress was named interim leader. The news came as Nvidia's market value slipped below four trillion dollars for the first time since July 2025. For employees and investors, the announcement raised a familiar workplace question: how should a company communicate an unexpected change at the top? Experts say the answer lies in clarity, honesty and timing. A good transition statement should be candid about what happened, constructive about what comes next, and clear about who is responsible in the interim. Silence, by contrast, creates confusion and rumor. Whether in a global corporation or a small team, leaders who communicate early and directly tend to keep trust intact. As the saying goes, the biggest problem in communication is the illusion that it has already taken place.
reading.translation: 周四，英伟达宣布黄仁勋辞去总裁、首席执行官及董事职务，即刻生效。公司未说明其离职原因。首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯被任命为临时领导人。这一消息传出之际，英伟达市值自2025年7月以来首次跌破4万亿美元。对员工和投资者而言，这一公告提出了一个职场中常见的问题：公司应如何就高层的意外变动进行沟通？专家认为，答案在于清晰、诚实与时机。一份好的过渡声明应当坦诚说明发生了什么、建设性地说明接下来的安排，并明确过渡期内由谁负责。相反，沉默只会制造困惑与谣言。无论是在跨国公司还是小团队中，尽早、直接沟通的领导者往往更能维持信任。正如那句名言所说：沟通中最大的问题，是误以为沟通已经发生了。
reading.sourceNote: 素材来源：ChinaDaily《Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; finance chief named interim leader》与 CGTN《NVIDIA's market value falls below $4 trillion》（2026-11-13），结合职场沟通主题改写，评论部分为教学性延伸。
